title: The Fix-It Machine
hook: Boots 的红靴子破了个洞，Dora 带他去找那台什么都能修的「超级修东西机器」。

cells.en: “I'm hiding!” Dora plays hide and seek in the jungle with Boots.
cells.cn: “我在躲呢！”Dora 和 Boots 在丛林里玩捉迷藏。

cells.en: “My boot!” Boots looks down. His red boot has a big hole in it.
cells.cn: “我的靴子！”Boots 低头一看，红靴子上破了一个大洞。

cells.en: “You just put in your boot,” and the machine will fix it right up.
cells.cn: “只要把靴子放进去，”机器就会把它修好。

cells.en: Map says: first go across Crocodile Lake, then to the Fix-It Machine.
cells.cn: 地图说：先穿过鳄鱼湖，再到修东西机器那儿。

cells.en: Everybody rows the boat. “Put your hands out in front of you!”
cells.cn: 大家一起划船：“把手伸到前面去！”

cells.en: A big furry troll sits on a log and eats a big piece of cheese.
cells.cn: 一个毛茸茸的大巨魔坐在木头上，啃着一大块奶酪。

cells.en: “It will take anything and fix it right up.” The old man smiles.
cells.cn: “不管什么，它都能修得好好的。”老爷爷笑着说。

cells.en: “My boot, my boot!” The old man gives Boots his red boot back.
cells.cn: “我的靴子，我的靴子！”老爷爷把红靴子还给 Boots。

cells.en: “We did it!” Confetti flies. Everything is fixed and everyone is happy.
cells.cn: “我们做到啦！”彩纸飞舞，东西全修好了，大家都很开心。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “The Fix-It Machine”.
ending: In the end, the old man fixes Boots' boot with the machine. My favorite part is ______.
